Liberal Democrat

Data period: 2024 election manifesto and analysis. Published 2024. Source updated not supplied. Published 2024-05-31. Source updated not supplied. Published 2024-06-06. Source updated not supplied.

This is a fixed past snapshot. No next release date is announced.

Selected official offer
Tax share buybacks by FTSE-100 firms.
Party source excerpt
Introducing a 4% tax on the share buyback schemes of FTSE-100 listed companies,
Scope
Tax on FTSE-100 firms buying back their own shares. IFS economist quoted by Full Fact assesses this plan.
Baseline
Party release uses current buyback levels, then allows for firms changing their behaviour. This is a revenue claim, not a spending cost.
Year
Annual revenue; the release gives no fiscal year.
Status
2024 election proposal; not current spending or a claim of policy now in force.
Costing
Party claim: annual tax revenue after changes in firms’ behaviour. Party source: estimating it would raise around £1.4bn a year.
Independent assessment
IFS: Stuart Adam, via Full Fact: surprised if a 4% tax on share buybacks in the UK raised much revenue
Source and dates
Party source: PDF page 14. Published 2024. Copy saved 2026-11-01. Party publisher. Saved PDF · Plain text. Costing: Why could this raise £1.4 billion?. Published 2024-05-31. Copy saved 2026-11-02. Saved source · Plain text. Assessment: Stuart Adam response. Published 2024-06-06. Copy saved 2026-11-02. Saved source · Plain text.
